title: Open-source route identity, independence, and fast peer selection
mode: Primary-source research and implementation-readiness update; research-only
scope: Disambiguate GDAL DXF, CAD/libopencad, and ODA-backed DWG driver routes.
Reconcile FreeCAD import/export backends and its DWG converter chain.
Preserve LibreCAD 3 as a same-codec downstream consumer rather than an independent DWG parser.
Provide a minimal question-driven peer route selector without adding routine validation.

sources.revision: Stable documentation reviewed 2026-10-19; exact runtime artifact remains to be pinned before any comparison.
sources.observed: The DXF driver is a separate route and accepts Binary DXF starting in 3.12. The read-only CAD driver uses internal or external libopencad and projects a documented subset of POINT, LINE, CIRCLE/ARC, and 3DFACE. The separate DWG driver uses ODA Teigha. OGR projections and direct DXF transport are different evidence lanes.

The successor project states support only for DWG R2000. This is a source-declared scope boundary, not independently executed evidence. GDAL CAD and direct libopencad must not be double-counted as two parser lineages.

sources.revision: Mutable documentation/source pages reviewed 2026-10-19; no application binary or converter was run.
sources.observed: FreeCAD documents distinct C++ and legacy Python import profiles and distinct C++ R14 and legacy R12 exporter profiles. The C++ importer omits text, dimensions, and attributes inside blocks; stock FreeCAD does not read ACIS/SAT solids. DWG passes through an external converter to DXF before the selected importer.

sources.revision: Mutable master documentation reviewed 2026-10-19; no LibreCAD 3 build was run.
sources.observed: DWG import is documented as opt-in, disabled by default, and read-only through libdxfrw's dwgRW. It is a downstream integration/consumer check using the same parser family, not an independent DWG decoder.

localEvidence: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing PAR-07/S8 route-specific comparator, consumer, and evidence ledger
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing GDAL DXF/CAD, FreeCAD, LibreCAD 3, and independent ACIS/AcDs boundaries
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: fixture policy excludes downloaded external drawings and permits local-from-scratch controls

assessment.planImpact: Adds a stage-aware route identity and independence rule plus a fast question-driven selection procedure. GDAL driver/backend and FreeCAD importer/exporter directions are not interchangeable; LibreCAD 3 is a same-codec consumer check. No new peer cadence, tests, fixtures, dependencies, or support claims are added.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review plus local plan crosswalk
method.limitations: The reviewed project documentation and main branches are mutable and describe candidate scope, not executed behavior of a pinned artifact. No claim of codec independence is made without source/build lineage evidence. GDAL OGR geometry projections and FreeCAD application pipelines are consumer evidence only for their declared profile; they are not whole-document or general ACIS semantics evidence.
